# Delta Air Lines

> Delta Air Lines provides comprehensive flight booking, travel planning, and customer support resources with integrated SkyMiles loyalty rewards and vacation packages.

Delta Air Lines is a major U.S. carrier offering domestic and international flights to destinations across the Caribbean, Europe, Asia, and South Pacific. The site features travel deals, booking management, customer service policies, and career opportunities for its global workforce.

## Key Topics

- SkyMiles
- Delta Vacations
- Flight Deals
- Passenger Rights
- Travel Planning
- Customer Support
- International Travel
- Frequent Flyer
- Booking Management
- Delta Comfort
- Medallion Status
- Gift Cards
- Delta Sync
- My Trips
- Fly Delta App

## Flight Deals & Destinations

- [Flight Deals by Region](https://www.delta.com/us/en/flight-deals/flight-deals-by-region): Regional flight deals to Europe, Asia, South America, and Caribbean destinations.
- [Flights to Caribbean](https://www.delta.com/us/en/flight-deals/caribbean-flights): Caribbean flight deals and vacation packages with low fare commitment and SkyMiles rewards.
- [Flights to Australia & South Pacific](https://www.delta.com/us/en/flight-deals/pacific-flights): Australia and South Pacific flight deals with Delta Vacations and SkyMiles rewards.

## Booking & Travel Planning

- [Travel Planning FAQs](https://www.delta.com/us/en/travel-planning-center/travel-planning-faqs): FAQs covering flight changes, eCredits, onboard experience, and booking management.
- [Certificates, eCredits & Gift Cards](https://www.delta.com/us/en/booking-information/ecredits-certificates-gift-cards): Information on Delta eCerts, eCredits, and gift cards for booking and redemption.
- [Travel Gift Cards + eGifts for Travelers](https://www.delta.com/us/en/gift-cards/overview): Delta gift cards and eGifts redeemable for flights and Delta Vacations packages.
- [Air + Rail](https://www.delta.com/us/en/booking-information/air-and-rail): Air + Rail program with seamless connections via Thalys Trains in Europe.

## Customer Support & Policies

- [Change Flight](https://www.delta.com/us/en/change-cancel/change-flight): Delta flight change policy, refund options, and applicable fees by ticket type.
- [Delayed or Canceled Flight](https://www.delta.com/us/en/change-cancel/delayed-or-canceled-flight): Options and passenger rights for delayed or canceled Delta flights with rebooking.
- [Customer Service Plan](https://www.delta.com/us/en/legal/customer-commitment): Delta customer service commitments covering passenger rights, baggage, and flight disruptions.
- [Airport Security Checkpoint & Screening](https://www.delta.com/us/en/check-in-security/airport-security): Airport security guidelines, TSA PreCheck info, and prohibited items for Delta travelers.

## Airline Partnerships & Services

- [China Eastern Partnership](https://www.delta.com/us/en/airline-partners/china-eastern): Delta and China Eastern airline partnership with SkyMiles benefits for US-China travel.
- [Delta Sync](https://www.delta.com/us/en/about-delta/sync): Delta Sync inflight experience with free Wi-Fi and exclusive SkyMiles member benefits.

## Careers

- [Careers Overview](https://www.delta.com/us/en/careers/overview): Delta careers overview with job opportunities for 100,000-strong global workforce.
- [Students & Early Careers](https://www.delta.com/us/en/careers/students-and-early-careers): Student internship, MBA, co-op, and rotational programs at Delta Air Lines.

## Legal & Reference

- [Contract of Carriage: U.S.](https://www.delta.com/us/en/legal/contract-of-carriage-dgr): Legal contract of carriage terms for domestic Delta, Delta Shuttle, and Delta Connection.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.delta.com/us/en/legal/terms-of-use): Delta website terms of use covering copyright, intellectual property and user restrictions.
- [Imprint](https://www.delta.com/us/en/legal/imprint): Delta Air Lines legal imprint with company registration and Frankfurt office details.

## Optional

- [User-Generated Content Terms of Use](https://www.delta.com/us/en/social/ugc-terms): Terms governing user-generated content and photo rights across Delta social media.
